Job Published:  7 July 2026

ABOUT THE BUSINESS
Little Corner BBQ is a contemporary Chinese restaurant located in Melbourne's CBD, specialising in authentic Chinese charcoal barbecue and regional Asian cuisine prepared using traditional cooking techniques and quality ingredients. The restaurant offers an extensive menu featuring premium meat, poultry, seafood, vegetable, and specialty barbecue dishes, complemented by freshly prepared side dishes and seasonal menu offerings.
Operating across lunch and dinner service, Little Corner BBQ is committed to delivering authentic flavours, consistent food quality, and exceptional customer service within a vibrant and fast-paced hospitality environment. The commercial kitchen focuses on fresh ingredient preparation, traditional Chinese barbecue cooking methods, quality control, efficient kitchen operations, and strict compliance with Australian food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Little Corner BBQ has an opportunity available for an experienced Cook to join its kitchen team on a full-time basis.
This is a hands-on operational role responsible for preparing, cooking, and presenting authentic Chinese barbecue dishes and a diverse range of Asian-inspired cuisine in accordance with established recipes, quality standards, and service requirements. The successful candidate will contribute to all aspects of kitchen operations including food preparation, commercial cooking, stock control, quality assurance, and maintaining a safe and efficient commercial kitchen environment.
The role requires the ability to manage allocated kitchen sections, coordinate workflow during busy lunch and dinner service periods, maintain consistency in food quality and presentation, and work collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house staff to ensure efficient service delivery and customer satisfaction.
This is a full-time permanent position based on a minimum 38-hour working week.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Food Preparation and Cooking
1.	Prepare, cook, and present a broad range of authentic Chinese barbecue dishes and Asian cuisine in accordance with established recipes and presentation standards.
2.	Prepare premium meat, poultry, seafood, vegetables, and other ingredients using appropriate preparation techniques including cutting, trimming, marinating, seasoning, skewering, and portioning.
3.	Apply appropriate commercial cooking techniques including charcoal grilling, roasting, stir-frying, deep-frying, steaming, braising, and sautéing while maintaining consistency in flavour, texture, and presentation.
4.	Monitor cooking times, temperatures, seasoning, and food quality throughout preparation and service.
5.	Prepare sauces, marinades, seasonings, and accompanying ingredients in accordance with established recipes and business standards.

Kitchen Operations and Service Delivery
1.	Support efficient kitchen workflow during lunch and dinner service to ensure timely preparation and delivery of customer orders.
2.	Manage allocated kitchen sections while maintaining organised, clean, and service-ready workstations.
3.	Work collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house staff to ensure accurate order preparation and efficient service delivery.
4.	Assist with daily menu preparation, specialty barbecue items, and seasonal menu offerings.
5.	Maintain consistency in food quality, presentation, and portion control across all menu items.

Stock Control and Kitchen Organisation
1.	Assist with receiving, inspecting, storing, and rotating food supplies in accordance with established stock control procedures.
2.	Apply FIFO stock rotation principles to minimise spoilage and maintain product freshness.
3.	Monitor ingredient usage and report stock shortages or purchasing requirements to management.
4.	Participate in stocktakes and maintain organised storage areas.
5.	Ensure appropriate labelling, storage, and handling of food products in accordance with food safety requirements.
Food Safety and Compliance
1.	Maintain compliance with Australian Food Safety Standards and safe food handling practices.
2.	Maintain high standards of hygiene and cleanliness throughout food preparation areas, equipment, utensils, and workstations.
3.	Monitor food storage, preparation, cooking, cooling, and holding temperatures to ensure compliance with food safety requirements.
4.	Follow workplace cleaning schedules, sanitation procedures, and operational policies.
5.	Comply with Workplace Health and Safety requirements, including the safe operation of commercial kitchen equipment.

General Duties and Team Contribution
1.	Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient workstation throughout each shift.
2.	Follow instructions from senior kitchen staff and management with accuracy and attention to detail.
3.	Work collaboratively within a team environment to support efficient kitchen operations during busy service periods.
4.	Demonstrate reliability, professionalism, punctuality, and a positive approach to work.
5.	Participate in ongoing workplace training and continuous professional development to enhance culinary knowledge and operational performance.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
1.	Relevant qualification in Commercial Cookery (Certificate III or higher) or a closely related field.
2.	Minimum one (1) year of relevant full-time experience within a commercial kitchen environment.
3.	Previous experience preparing Chinese barbecue, Asian cuisine, or similar regional cuisine within a commercial restaurant environment will be highly regarded.
4.	Demonstrated experience preparing and cooking food within a commercial restaurant or hospitality environment.
5.	Sound knowledge of Australian Food Safety Standards, food hygiene, and safe food handling practices.
6.	Ability to work efficiently within a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment.
7.	Availability to work evenings, weekends, public holidays, and rostered shifts as required.

KEY COMPETENCIES

8.	Attention to detail and quality control.
9.	Food safety and regulatory compliance.
10.	Commitment to continuous improvement and professional standards.

Please submit a one-page CV outlining your relevant qualifications, experience, and availability.

Our client is an award-winning luxury hotel, renowned as a vibrant landmark where modern sophistication meets unparalleled service. They are celebrated for creating immersive, memorable experiences for their guests, from the elegance of their accommodations to the dynamic energy of their world-class dining and entertainment precinct. The culinary philosophy is centred on contemporary, produce-driven cuisine, showcasing the finest local and seasonal ingredients with artistry and precision. They are seeking a passionate and skilled Chef de Partie to join their exceptional culinary brigade.

About the Role
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a dedicated Chef de Partie to become an integral part of their high-energy kitchen team. This is not just a job; it's an opportunity to contribute to a culinary landscape known for its innovation and excellence. You will be responsible for managing a specific section of the kitchen, ensuring every dish that leaves your station meets the impeccable standards expected by their discerning guests. You will play a key role in bringing their celebrated menus to life, working with premium ingredients in a fast-paced, professional, and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
Menu Development & Kitchen Management
• Collaborate with the Senior Chef team in the creative process of researching, developing, and costing new menu items that align with the hotel's contemporary and seasonal culinary direction.
• Manage the efficient ordering and organisation of high-quality food supplies for your section, minimising waste while maintaining the highest standards of ingredient quality.
• Assist in calculating detailed food and labour costs for your designated kitchen section to ensure financial targets and budgetary guidelines are consistently met.

Culinary Execution & Quality Control
• Expertly prepare, cook, and present a diverse range of dishes to the exact specification of the Head Chef, demonstrating advanced technical skills and a keen eye for detail.
• Meticulously monitor the quality, flavour, and visual presentation of all dishes at every stage, from initial mise en place to final plating, ensuring consistency and excellence.
• Take ownership of your section during service periods, demonstrating leadership, organisation, and the ability to perform under pressure to deliver a seamless dining experience.

Leadership, Training & Hygiene Standards
• Proactively participate in the training and development of Commis Chefs and apprentices, mentoring them in classic and modern cooking techniques and procedures.
• Uphold and rigorously enforce the company’s comprehensive health, safety, and hygiene regulations, including HACCP protocols, to ensure a pristine and safe working environment at all times.
• Foster clear and effective communication by discussing daily preparation, potential challenges, and special dietary requirements with Managers, Sous Chefs, and service staff.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
• Proven experience as a Chef de Partie or Demi Chef de Partie within a high-volume, à la carte or fine-dining kitchen environment.
• A formal qualification in Commercial Cookery (Certificate III or equivalent) is highly regarded.
• A genuine passion for contemporary, produce-driven cuisine and a commitment to culinary excellence.
• Demonstrated ability to manage a section, lead by example, and support junior team members.
• Comprehensive knowledge of kitchen operations, including but not limited to butchery, seafood preparation, and sauce work.
• An unwavering commitment to maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and food safety.
• Excellent communication skills, a positive and collaborative team spirit, and the ability to thrive in a demanding, fast-paced environment.
• Flexibility to work across a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

If you are a culinary professional ready to take the next step in your career within a celebrated and dynamic hotel environment, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience via the link below.

Please note: All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality. We are acting as the exclusive recruitment partner for this role and our client's identity will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates.

Diploma Qualified Early Childhood Educator – Full Time

Jellybabies Early Learning Centre – Sunshine Beach, QLD

Jellybabies Early Learning Centre is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic Diploma Qualified Early Childhood Educator to join our team in a full-time position.

We are a family-owned early learning service committed to providing high-quality education and care in a welcoming, supportive and child-focused environment. We are looking for an educator who is passionate about early childhood education, values positive relationships and is committed to creating meaningful learning experiences for children.

About the Position

This is a full-time position working across a rotating roster. Applicants must be available to work a variety of shifts within our operating hours, which may include:

Early shifts commencing at 6:30 am
Late shifts finishing at 6:30 pm
A variety of shifts between these times

Our service operates 52 weeks of the year, excluding public holidays. Applicants must therefore be available to work throughout the year, including during school holiday periods.

Employment conditions and remuneration will be provided in accordance with the Children’s Services Award, based on qualifications and experience.

Key Responsibilities

The successful applicant will be responsible for:

Providing high-quality education and care for children
Developing warm, respectful and responsive relationships with children and families
Planning and implementing engaging, play-based learning experiences
Contributing to observations, learning stories, individual learning plans and program documentation
Supporting children’s wellbeing, development, agency and sense of belonging
Implementing the Early Years Learning Framework and the National Quality Standard
Maintaining active supervision and ensuring children’s health and safety
Supporting children through routines, transitions and daily care experiences
Working collaboratively with educators, room leaders, management and external professionals
Communicating professionally and respectfully with families
Maintaining accurate records and completing required documentation
Contributing to reflective practice, continuous improvement and the service Quality Improvement Plan
Following all service policies, procedures and Child Safe Standards
Assisting with the daily setup, cleaning and maintenance of learning environments
Essential Requirements

Applicants must have:

A completed Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care, or an approved equivalent qualification
At least 1 year relevant experience working in an early education and care service
A current Queensland Working with Children Check, or the ability to obtain one
Current First Aid, CPR, Asthma and Anaphylaxis qualifications, or a willingness to obtain them
Sound knowledge of the Early Years Learning Framework and National Quality Standard
An understanding of child development and play-based learning
Knowledge of child protection responsibilities and child-safe practices
The ability to work full-time across a rotating roster between 6:30 am and 6:30 pm
Australian working rights
Personal Attributes

We are looking for an educator who demonstrates:

A genuine passion for working with children
Warmth, patience, empathy and kindness
Reliability, punctuality and a strong work ethic
Professionalism and personal accountability
Strong verbal and written communication skills
The ability to build positive relationships with children, families and colleagues
A calm and responsive approach to supporting children’s emotions and behaviour
Initiative and the ability to work independently when required
A positive and cooperative approach to teamwork
Flexibility and adaptability within a busy early learning environment
Strong organisational and time-management skills
Attention to detail when completing documentation and records
A willingness to receive feedback and participate in ongoing professional development
Respect for diversity, culture, individual family circumstances and inclusive practices
A commitment to protecting children’s safety, dignity, privacy and rights
A reflective mindset and willingness to contribute ideas for continuous improvement
What We Offer
A full-time position within a supportive, family-owned service
A welcoming and collaborative team environment
Opportunities for professional learning and development
Support from experienced room leaders, educational leadership and management
Opportunities to contribute to service projects, curriculum development and continuous improvement
Award wages and employment conditions
A workplace that values educator wellbeing, professional contribution and positive relationships
How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining:

Your relevant qualifications and experience
Your availability to work across our rotating roster
Your approach to building relationships with children and families
Why you would like to join the Jellybabies Early Learning Centre team

Only applicants who meet the essential qualification and availability requirements will be considered.
